# HollyOaks on the Marsh (concept by Kerblabs)

> Private country estate venue on 18 acres in Savannah, Georgia, established 1941. Facts from hollyoaksotm.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Instagram: @hollyoaks_otm
- Events per year: 8
- Visits and tours: by appointment only

## Spaces
- 1941 Manor Home
- Heirloom Gardens
- 1927 Guest Cottage
- Sailcloth tent option

## FAQ
- Prices? Not disclosed on their site.
